triggers.detailsText: In FY26, Birlasoft’s total operating income (TOI) witnessed a de-growth of 1.2% year-on-year (YoY) in INR terms and de-growth of 6.5% in USD terms (US$597.5 million in FY26 against US$635.4 million in FY25), owing to a softened demand environment in the Indian IT services industry, emanating from macroeconomic headwinds resulting in lower discretionary… Going forward, CareEdge Ratings expects the company’s PBILDT margins to remain stable at ~15% over the near-to-medium term. Operations are also geographically concentrated in the US (83% and 86% of revenue share in Q1FY27 and FY26, respectively ) while being exposed to foreign exchange fluctuation risk, client concentration risk, employee attrition risk, and changes in policies/ macro environment across key operating markets, including America and Europe among others.
